baseline: New clean process using the same tail-fixed runtime as profile and final clean.
adaptive_scope: Clean baseline already observed. This is an exploratory observer calibration, not a blinded confirmatory performance study.
native_identity: Identical executable and runtime to successful model bridge; only whitelisted GGML_VK_PERF_LOGGER environment differs.
design: Three NEW processes CLEAN_A / FIXED_CONCURRENT_PROFILE / CLEAN_B, same executable, same tail-fixed DLL. Each3 fresh contexts; third-context15 decode medians for coarse calibration.
qualification: All48 complete logits must match original clean reference bytes across process; all greedy IDs identical; first mismatch stops next GPU process.
calibration: Unchanged: third-context median decode clean A/B and profile vs EACH clean all within [0.90,1.10]. Only coarse necessary observer gate; no per-op perturbation or critical-path proof.
attribution: Parse groups delimited by existing synchronization. Only groups containing exclusively attention-core operations may count as pure attention. Mixed groups stay mixed; no per-op apportionment or Amdahl extrapolation.
failure: Preserve failed process/qualification; no automatic GPU retry. Scientific calibration rejection is a result, not permission to retune the screen.

budget.charge: full native parent wall incl initialization, capture and cleanup

previous_observer_rejection: Nonconcurrent logger slowed median decode by12.03-12.54%; failed frozen10% gate. Preserve rejection. New observer uses existing synchronization groups, same10% gate, same binary; no threshold retuning.
repair: Terminal timestamp closes final group; attribution filters empty/non-compute nodes with same predicate as executor. Previous tail-fixed log counted n=0 inactive nodes in group labels; preserve it.
completeness: All3 profile-context tables must contain output projection m151936 n1 k4096 exactly16 times; QK/AV/softmax each5004 effective occurrences; all raw full logits equal original clean reference. Mixed groups not fractionally apportioned. No reported matrix group may have n=0. Three new same-DLL processes must retain exact logits, counter invariants, unchanged10% observer gate.
decision: If corrected coarse observer passes and full output/reference and counter checks pass, report instrumented group costs with strict limits; otherwise retain failure and do not claim bottleneck.
